text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

translations.asad: SAY: "O you who deny the truth!
"I do not worship that which you worship,
translations.sahih: I do not worship what you worship.

translations.asad: and neither do you worship that which I worship!
translations.sahih: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

translations.asad: "And I will not worship ~hat which you have [ever] worshipped,
translations.sahih: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

translations.asad: and neither will you [ever] worship that which I worship.
translations.sahih: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

translations.asad: Unto you, your moral law, and unto me, mine!"
translations.sahih: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
